title: Electrical Power — DC Generation — Transformer Rectifier Output Bus Bar and Contactor Replacement
abstract: Retrofit of the machined output bus bar and the silver-plated contactor set on the direct current generation installation, bringing delivered aircraft to the production standard cut in during 2018.

sections.planning_reason: Nine operators reported discoloured insulation and a smell of hot varnish in the forward avionics bay after long ground power periods. Teardown showed the bolted bus bar stack relaxing by up to a fifth of its assembly preload, giving a joint resistance that raises the local temperature by forty degrees at full rectifier output. The condition gives no flight deck indication and no in-service symptom until the insulation is already damaged. Aircraft delivered from MSN S01020 carry the improved standard from build.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaces the laminated output bus bar with an item that has a machined contact land and a captive Belleville stack at each terminal, so that preload is maintained through the thermal cycle. The transformer rectifier relay assembly is replaced by the outboard relay kit with a silver-plated contact set, and a backshell is added at the outboard feed so that the harness screen terminates on the bus bar housing. The bay ground stud is re-faced and the contactor and circuit breaker terminals are re-torqued to a revised value.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Isolate the aircraft from ground power and from the battery, and put the warning notices in position. WARNING: DO NOT WORK ON THE DIRECT CURRENT INSTALLATION UNTIL THE BATTERY IS DISCONNECTED AND THE TERMINALS ARE CAPPED. Do AMM-S-24-30-11-000-031-A to remove the transformer rectifier unit and the bus bar assembly. Do a detailed visual inspection of the bay structure behind the bus bar and record any heat damage. Install the machined bus bar D2430110204063 with the Belleville stacks at each terminal and torque to the value in the accomplishment instructions. Install the relay kit GIDE140223-63 in place of the relay assembly D2430113213358. Install the backshell PE30449-35 at the outboard feed and terminate the harness screen on the housing. Re-face the ground stud and measure the bonding resistance. Do AMM-S-24-30-11-400-031-A to install the transformer rectifier unit. Do the direct current generation operational test and a thermographic survey after thirty minutes at full output. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to twin-engine and four-engine aircraft from MSN S00003 to MSN S01012 that are not already at the machined bus bar standard. One aircraft is excluded because it carries a non-standard rectifier arrangement fitted for a flight test programme. Aircraft from MSN S01020 onward are post-modification from build and are not affected.
sections.material_note: Kit K2430-1071-01 contains the bus bar, the relay kit, the backshell and the Belleville stacks. Lead time is fourteen weeks. The removed relay assembly is returned to Aeralis for contact analysis; the removed bus bar is scrapped locally.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
